content.about: Estonia is a small Baltic country on the Gulf of Finland, with forests, bogs and over 2,000 islands. Tallinn, its capital, has a well-preserved medieval old town. It is one of the most digital countries in the world. Estonians are known for big song festivals.

standout.text: Estonia was the first country to offer online voting in a national election, in 2007.

didYouKnow: Skype was developed by engineers in Estonia.
About half of Estonia is covered by forest.
Estonia offers e-residency to people anywhere in the world.
